Remark
[Index form as the Hessian of energy] ↗ rem:dc-ch9-2-7 1. ch9:2.12At a geodesic $\gamma \in \Omega _{p,q}$, the quadratic form $2I_a(V,V)$ is the Hessian $d^2E(V,V)$ of the energy functional in the direction of the endpoint-vanishing field $V$.
